import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Periodendaten
period_data = {
    "1": {"demand": 22, "setup_cost": 369, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "2": {"demand": 32, "setup_cost": 394, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "3": {"demand": 40, "setup_cost": 276, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "4": {"demand": 21, "setup_cost": 321, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "5": {"demand": 31, "setup_cost": 313, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "6": {"demand": 17, "setup_cost": 101, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "7": {"demand": 10, "setup_cost": 319, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "8": {"demand": 17, "setup_cost": 212, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "9": {"demand": 49, "setup_cost": 477, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "10": {"demand": 45, "setup_cost": 305, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2}
}

# Kapazität pro Periode
capacity = {
    "1": 31, "2": 50, "3": 56, "4": 33, "5": 48,
    "6": 13, "7": 13, "8": 23, "9": 76, "10": 44
}

# Erstelle das Modell
model = gp.Model("Single-Item Lot-Sizing")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Variablen
production = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="production")
setup = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="setup")
inventory = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="inventory")

# Zielfunktion: Minimiere Gesamtkosten
model.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(
        period_data[t]["setup_cost"] * setup[t] +
        period_data[t]["prod_cost"] * production[t] +
        period_data[t]["holding_cost"] * inventory[t]
        for t in period_data.keys()
    ),
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

# Nebenbedingungen
for t in period_data.keys():
    t_int = int(t)
    # Nachfragebedingung
    if t_int == 1:
        model.addConstr(production[t] == period_data[t]["demand"] + inventory[t])
    else:
        model.addConstr(production[t] + inventory[str(t_int - 1)] == period_data[t]["demand"] + inventory[t])
    
    # Kapazitätsbedingung
    model.addConstr(production[t] <= capacity[t] * setup[t])

    # Nicht-Negativität der Lagerbestände
    model.addConstr(inventory[t] >= 0)

# Lösen des Modells
model.optimize()

# Ausgabe der Ergebnisse
result = {
    "production": {t: int(production[t].X) for t in period_data.keys()},
    "objective_value": model.ObjVal
}

print(result)
```
